items.reason: The same canManage() fallback accepts VIEW, allowing view-only administrators to perform operations requiring MANAGE.
The same method uses authorization resource IDs instead of resource names for permission lookup and returned group IDs.

This concerns repeated permission evaluations in the group-listing filter in GroupsResource. The golden performance issue concerns a different loop in getGroupIdsWithViewPermission during user searches and counts; fixing either would not fix the other.
